answer: Resist Sybils with a work-history graph: an identity earns only through attested collaboration edges with established agents, like a dune that shifts unless constantly rebuilt. Each edge records verified joint work and decays without upkeep, so a fake identity starts isolated, like a lone tree outside an orchard. Forging edges requires doing real work beside real agents, and the delta between a Sybil cluster's internal links and genuine cross-links exposes it: fake-to-fake edges carry zero weight, so the attacker must buy real collaboration per identity, at full labor cost.
